purpose: Learned toy video diffusion + GRPO with a verifiable motion reward. Declared before any training.

video.motion: straight line, no bounce, start chosen so path stays in canvas
video.note: reduced from 48/28 after measuring 3 s/step on MPS; digits bilinearly resized 28->20

data_splits.denoiser: MNIST train[0:60000], fresh random clips each batch

diffusion.policy_sampler: DDIM eta=1, 40 steps; final step deterministic and not a policy action

gate.legible: evaluator mean crop confidence >= 0.7 and class consistency >= 0.75
gate.rule: if gate fails, no GRPO is run

reward_train: guard(ink) * [0.4 * proxy_conf * proxy_consistency + 0.6 * max(0,cos(centroid displacement, requested)) * speed_match]

grpo.trainable: full denoiser, reference = frozen pretrained copy

evaluation.primary: direction success (cross-correlation displacement angle error < 22.5 deg AND evaluator-legible)
evaluation.uncertainty: bootstrap 95% CI over clips, per seed and pooled
